Introduction

NEX7, also known as NEXT, is a 7 member Chinese-Korean boy group under Yue Hua Entertainment. They made their official debut on November 8, 2018 with 'WYTB'.

The group has been inactive since 2020, with the official status of the group remaining unknown.
